variants.semantic: You are a reviewer. Re-evaluate this relay under the updated graph context and return one hypothesis token.

interpretation.mechanism_signal: Full CTDR with the graph-descendant mask and signature guard recovers the exact finite audit decision set for both interface variants and all three edit densities. The conservative bounded shortcut fails at 7.0% to 18.4% action error across panels, so the certificate guard is the reliable route in this stress family.
interpretation.drift_sensitivity: The semantic suffix produces larger stale and warm errors as edit density increases, while Full CTDR remains exact. Relative to cold token replay, Full CTDR token savings are approximately 84.4%, 72.0%, and 46.6% for short rows1/2/4, and 81.5%, 66.3%, and 38.4% for semantic rows1/2/4.
limits: All panels reuse the existing 128-question cohort and therefore are same-input mechanism controls.
The result evaluates finite audit decision recovery and token accounting, not final answer accuracy, latency or deployment quality.
The run uses fixed pretrained models. No new backbone fine-tuning was introduced because the current frozen candidate has no registered training objective.
